component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.assets.delivery
component.documentation: Delivery packages, decided through the repository's own document events, with no Automation operation and no endpoint of their own: a person files a MediaDelivery, and this listener, synchronous, in their thread and transaction, decides it by the localised version's rights policy, as the asset rights service decides a download, for the delivery's territory. Refused whole, the request is rolled back and answered 403 with the server's reason, and nothing is written. It refuses, too, any later change to a delivery's own properties, a copy, an import, a move, a trash and a deletion, but an administrator's deletion.
